note: Adapted from the entry '42. Coptotermes minutissimus Kemner' in the genus Coptotermes account of the Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India; the original is in English. The original states explicitly that no type material was available and that the description and measurements are taken from the original description of Kemner (1934). The alate is recorded in the original as Unknown.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The species is so far known only from the soldier; its pronotum is slightly saddle-shaped, a character that distinguishes it from all other species of Coptotermes in the Papuan region.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, the outer edge of the mandibles brown; body white; head sparsely hairy; the posterior margin of each abdominal tergite with a row of long bristles, the other hairs irregular. Head flat and arched, widest in the middle, narrowing anteriorly. Postmentum not strongly narrowed, the anterior part small and wide. Fontanelle tubular, small, the outer rim of its opening not projecting. Apex of the labrum brightly tapering. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 shorter than segment 4. Pronotum more than half as long as wide, weakly saddle-shaped, the margins arched and with a shallow median notch.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (soldier, mm): head length (with mandibles) 1.80—1.85; head length (without mandibles) 1.13—1.22; head width 0.99—1.02; pronotum width 0.59—0.63; pronotum length 0.31—0.35. The type specimens can no longer be traced (Types: Not traceable in the original).
